tei:div.tei:p: 'dzam bu gling pa'i rgyal rabs spyi phyin gyi stong thun zur tsam bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa sti/ sngon bsags bsod nams du mas rgyu byas zhing*/ /rigs rus cho 'a'aphrengs kla'abrangablaldan pas 'askyen klarkyenablabyas te/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms pas gling bzhi la/ /'khor lo'i sgyur rgyal rnams la'ang bstod par bgyi | | spyir du lha mi'i rjer gyur rgyal rigs la/ /rgyas par phye na sum brgya drug cu yod/ /de las bsdus na rnam pa gnyis bshad de/ /dag pa sangs rgyas rje dang ma dag sems can rje/ /sangs rgyas rje ni sku gsum 'gro don mdzad/ /sems can rje la rnam pa lngar dbye nas/ /stong gsum dbang byed spyi phud rgyal po dang*/ / sa 'dzin rgyal po phyogs skyong rgyal po dang*/ /rigs drug rgyal po 'dzam gling rgyal po dang*/ /lnga po de yang 'dzam gling sog kha'i rgyal po la/ /bskos dang gdung rgyud glo bur rgyal por bshad/ /rgyal po de gsum 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'askyana'aklarkyenabla/ de la spyi phud rgyal po tshangs pa dang*/ /sa 'dzin brgya byin phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi/ /rigs drug rgyal po gshin rje chos rgyal dang*/ / 'dzam gling gdung rgyud rgyal po mang bkur rgyud/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal spyi bo skyes la sogs/ /gser dngul zangs lcags dbang sgyur rgyal po yin/ /bod kyi rgyal po blo bur rgyal por grags/ /bskos pa'i rgyal po phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po yin/ / rgya gar chos kyi rgyal por bsko ba ni/ /byin rlabs bum pa glang chen snas bzung nas | | de'i su la dbang bskur de la bkod/ /rgya nag gtsug lag rgyal por bsko ba ni/ /rgya'i khang pa shin du mtho ba la/ /shel gyi 'baskras klaskasabla btsugs su thar de la bsko/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal por bskau ba ni/ /dpag chen bzhis mda' bzhi char phyogs bzhir 'phangs/ mda' bzhi dus su zin na de la bskau ba yin/ /stag gzig nor gyi rgyal por bskau ba ni/ /rin chen gling nas nor bu sus 'along klalonablagyis/

/nor gyi bdag po de la bskau ba yin/ / bskos pa'i rgyal po bzhi'i ston pa ni/ /rgya gar rgyal po sngon sbyangs las 'phro can | | sangs rgyas chos kyi snod du rung bas na/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pas ston pa mdzad | | rgya nag gtsug lag 'bacad kladapyadablakyis 'dul gzigs nas/ / mkhyen rab bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ /gab tse sum brgya drug cu ston par mdzad/ /ge sar dmag gi 'dul bar gzigs nas su/ /lha mo pañci ka'i bu lnga brgya bo/ /de 'dra dmag tu sprul nas ston pa mdzad/ /stag gzig nor gyi 'dul bar gzigs nas su/ /'phags pa nor 'dzin sku sprul ston pa mdzad| |rgya gar chos rgyal ma rig mun pa sel/ /rgya nag rgyal po legs nyes me long ston/ /ge sar rgyal po dmag gis dgra dpung 'dul/ /stag gzig rgyal pos dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /ces bshad pa rnams rgyal rab spyi'i stong thun zur tsam ma ོ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/rgyal rabs spyi phyin gyi stong thun/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 3-
